title: Turn `st.Page` into a proper class
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Today, `st.Page` isn't a class itself but returns an object of type `StreamlitPage`. Same for the return type of `st.navigation`. This is a bit confusing to users and in our docs. Can we change `st.Page`, so it's a proper class?

### Why?

Less confusion. 

### How?

_No response_

_No response_
